s: Pine Valley is known for skiing, but winter visitors are declining because of shorter snow seasons. Local businesses want a year-round strategy that supports small hotels, restaurants and outfitters.
The executive director (judge) wants you and your partner to recommend how to market the destination across seasons.
f: Winter visitors: 410,000, down 18% in five years
p: Explain the concept of market and market identification
Describe factors used by marketers to position products/services
Explain the nature of marketing plans
Identify the elements of the promotional mix
Explain the impact of the environment on tourism
n: Identifies target markets for each season
Positions Pine Valley by experience, not only snow
Plans seasonal packages and partnerships
Uses digital, partnerships and public relations
Considers climate impacts and sustainability
q: How would you convince businesses to stay open in the spring?
How would you measure the success of the campaign?

Conduct a risk assessment of an event

Recommends training, emergency contacts and medical plans
Creates reporting procedures and parent communication
